title: SR 26-2 Attachment: Supervisory Guidance on Model Risk Management (revised; supersedes SR 11-7 / OCC 2011-12)
authors_or_organization: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System; FDIC; OCC
limitations: Supervisory guidance (not a rule); states expectations, not compliance or effects. Supersedes SR 11-7 (April 2011), so lead text quoted from SR 11-7 (e.g., vendors expected to provide developmental evidence) is no longer in the current Fed text in that detail. Footnote 3 places generative and agentic AI models outside scope. Applies to banking organizations' models, not to advisory reports generally; transfer to IE/advisor reports is by analogy.

title: FDIC Examination Modules: Model Risk Management - Core Analysis Procedures (10/25)
limitations: Examiner procedures; examiners 'are not expected to perform every procedure at every institution'. Shows what examiners may look for, not what banks actually do. References SR 11-7/FIL-22-2017, which SR 26-2 superseded in April 2026; may be revised.

title: Guidance on Due Diligence Requirements in Determining Whether Securities Are Eligible for Investment (77 FR 35259)
authors_or_organization: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC)
limitations: Supervisory guidance implementing Dodd-Frank s.939A for national banks/FSAs; states expectations, not observed practice or effects. Securities investment context (not project loans). Page locators inferred from Federal Register page headers in extracted text.

title: 12 CFR Part 1 (Investment Securities), sections 1.2(d) 'Investment grade' and 1.5 'Safe and sound banking practices; credit information required' (current eCFR text)
authors_or_organization: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) / eCFR
limitations: Regulatory text only; the April 2026 amendment to 1.5 was not reviewed for what it changed. Same regulatory package as WS2-S03 (not independent evidence).

title: Interagency Guidance on Third-Party Relationships: Risk Management (88 FR 37920)
limitations: Covers business arrangements/outsourced activities broadly, not specifically purchased analysis or advisory reports; analogy only. Exact FR page for quoted passages not pinned (text extracted without page mapping).

title: Final Report: Guidelines on loan origination and monitoring (EBA/GL/2020/06)
limitations: Full PDF retrieved; only sections 5.2.6-5.2.11 (incl. project finance) and para. 91 reviewed in detail. EU guidelines (comply-or-explain); obligation, not observed practice.

limitations: Statute text only; interpretive case law (e.g., Brehm v. Eisner, 746 A.2d 244 (Del. 2000)) not retrieved (Justia 403; CourtListener API requires authentication). Applies to corporate directors, not lender credit committees directly.
